tone.target: bright early-60s clean rhythm with slight amp breakup
tone.profile: bright early-60s clean rhythm with slight amp breakup
tone.summary: A bright, dry 60s rhythm tone achieved using a Vox-style amp model (AC30 TB) with light compression and subtle room ambience, mimicking early British pop sounds.
corrections: aim for slight breakup, not full clean
